title: Pod Salt Fusion Cola with Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Tasty’s Cola with Lime is every bit as refreshing as a sweet, fizzy cola, made even more so with sublime dash of zesty lime. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
